meaning:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.7.25
§ Zeeb = "wolf"
one of the two princes of Midian mentioned in the conquest; brought to bay in a winepress

elsewhere.note: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then…
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
